items.title: Kolibri: A Sovereign Open-Weight Model
items.title_zh: Aleph Alpha 发布主权开源权重智能体模型 Kolibri
items.title_en: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, a sovereign open-weight agentic LLM
items.summary: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight agentic LLM accompanied by an exceptionally detailed technical report and abstention-trained anti-hallucination behavior, drawing both praise for transparency and skepticism about its sovereignty claims.

items.title: Qt 6.12 LTS 发布，支持 HarmonyOS
items.title_zh: Qt 6.12 LTS 发布，首次官方支持 HarmonyOS
items.title_en: Qt 6.12 LTS Released With Official HarmonyOS Support
items.summary: Qt 6.12 LTS has been released with five years of maintenance and adds Huawei HarmonyOS as an officially supported LTS platform.
